Tempest has vanished.

The statement was not altogether true, the Twin Eyes knew Tempest still existed, somewhere, but the Deep was empty without his presence.

Tempest had probably gone off hiding, recent events had not gone in his favour. Even though the Twin Eyes could easily look until they found him, they felt no inclination to. After all, silence, solitude, and such related things were sacred, and even the embodiment of silence must sometimes deafen their ears.

Not to mention, there was an opportunity here, a small experiment, of a sort.

Silence, Void, Darkness, were somewhat like the waters. They must come and go, ebb and flow. Darkness cannot stay when dawn breaks over the horizon. The silence must yield when the orchestra begins to play.

Yet they always return. Just as the sun always sets, just like the music must always end. Darkness and Silence must always be waiting to reclaim their ground, to fill the absence and the empty void.

Now, with Tempest gone, the situation was perfect.

Aeon grabbed the Daiou-ika. Long have they released a darkness, and only darkness. Andromeda was bemused by the thought process. After all, there wasn't much to see in the Deep. It would be more important if the others couldn't hear.

Andromeda's eye glowed, peering through the Daiou-ika into it's very being. Seeing what the Daiou-ika was, the Twins set to work. It was a minor touch, a small gesture, one that Tempest would likely fail to notice.

Aeon found the part of the Daiou-ika that created darkness, and altered it, a little. It did exactly what it did before, except now it did more.

Those who were unwelcome would find only silence in the darkness. They would strain and listen, but they will not hear. As they were once given darkness, they were now given silence.

To add a property to something, a very particular act, an odd thought. Certainly it had been an interesting experience. To alter life in any way was strange indeed, it took some consideration about what every part did, all their functions. Care had to be taken so that a modification does not destroy the whole, but the Twins thought they had succeeded.

The Twins then vanished, returning to the Void. This event had given them food for thought. Of course, that meant there would need to be even more experiments.
Andromeda and Aeon buff the Daiou-Ika, now allowing its darkness to render unwelcome listeners deaf as well as blind. They find the process interesting.
